summary: ci(workflows): add native macOS and Windows integration test matrix

delivery.outcome: GitHub Actions CI executes quick-scan, cache-classification, CLI, anonymization, rollback, and POA/MCP integration tests natively on macOS (macos-latest) and Windows (windows-latest) inside the canonical 'test' matrix job alongside Ubuntu Python 3.10-3.12.
nonGoals: Modifying .governance/required-checks.json or adding separate top-level workflow job identifiers.

architecture.decision: Extend jobs.test.strategy.matrix in .github/workflows/ci.yml with macos-latest and windows-latest Python 3.12 matrix entries using core.autocrlf=false before checkout so managed SHA-256 governance gates and cross-platform quick/cache integration tests run natively under the governed 'test' job.

validation.evidence: YAML syntax and canonical 'test' matrix job definition pass required-checks validation.
governance-check.sh passes with zero errors and zero warnings.
